title: Writing --- Four Lines, And The Joiner That Moves Nothing
label: ch:fr-quatre-lignes
canDo: I can write four connected lines to a named reader, joining with et and mais and giving a reason with parce que, keeping ordinary word order after it.

payoff.summary: Complete FR-W04-quatre-lignes: four lines to one reader, at least one joined with et or mais and one with parce que, then check the words after parce que are in ordinary order.
payoff.note: The contrast is the teaching: German's weil drags the verb to the end and French's parce que touches nothing. That makes French easier to write and harder to hear -- only the two words mark the join, which is why they are written in full.
